请使用配置中的项目钱包，并切换到部署演练网络。: Use the configured project wallet and switch to the deployment rehearsal network.
未检测到 MetaMask，请在安装扩展的浏览器中打开此地址。: MetaMask was not found. Open this address in a browser with the extension installed.
钱包会显示预计手续费。点击后，请在 MetaMask 中核对并确认。: Your wallet will show the estimated fee. Review and confirm the deployment in MetaMask.
地址和交易回执已通过节点核验，并保存在本轮部署记录目录。: The address and receipt have been verified against the node and saved in this rehearsal’s records directory.
已发出的交易不会因刷新而重新发送。若钱包已发送但页面未收到结果，请粘贴交易哈希继: Refreshing will not resend a transaction. If your wallet sent it but the page missed the result, paste the transaction hash to resume verification.
关闭终端会结束这条测试链；下次启动是新一轮演练。历史文件保留，当前游戏存档不受影: Closing the terminal ends this test chain. The next launch starts a new rehearsal. History files are retained and your game save is unaffected.
请先启动本地部署入口。: Start the local deployment console first.
部署服务暂不可用。: The deployment service is temporarily unavailable.
钱包中已有待处理请求，请先打开 MetaMask。: A wallet request is already pending. Open MetaMask to review it.
钱包操作未完成，请检查 MetaMask；若已发送交易，请用交易哈希恢复。: The wallet operation did not complete. Check MetaMask; if it sent a transaction, recover it with the transaction hash.
请切换到配置中的项目钱包。: Switch to the configured project wallet.
请切换到部署演练网络。: Switch to the deployment rehearsal network.
钱包已变化，请重新检查后部署。: The wallet changed. Check it again before deploying.
钱包未返回有效交易哈希，请在 MetaMask 中查看交易记录。: The wallet did not return a valid transaction hash. Check its transaction history.
节点网络与部署计划不一致。: The node network does not match the deployment plan.
当前入口只开放本地部署演练。: This console only supports local deployment rehearsals.
测试链已变化，请停止并重新启动部署入口。: The test chain changed. Stop and restart the deployment console.
这笔交易不属于当前部署计划。: This transaction does not match the current deployment plan.
节点暂未找到交易，请保留交易哈希后重试。: The node has not found this transaction yet. Keep its hash and try again.
交易区块已变化，请稍后重新检查。: The transaction block changed. Check again shortly.
部署回执中的合约地址不匹配。: The contract address in the receipt does not match.
合约代码不存在或已变化。: The contract code is missing or has changed.
本轮已有部署记录，不能覆盖。: This rehearsal already has a deployment record. It cannot be overwritten.
已记录的部署无法在当前链上验证。: The saved deployment cannot be verified on the current chain.
部署计划已变化，请刷新页面。: The deployment plan changed. Refresh the page.
已有部署正在处理，请继续检查原交易。: A deployment is already in progress. Continue checking the original transaction.
部署状态已变化，请刷新页面。: The deployment state changed. Refresh the page.
替换交易必须使用原交易的序号。: A replacement must use the original transaction nonce.
请从本机部署页面操作。: Use the local deployment page for this action.
本地节点或记录暂不可用，请保留交易哈希后重试。: The local node or records are temporarily unavailable. Keep the transaction hash and try again.
不支持这个部署网络。: This deployment network is not supported.
部署计划的确认策略无效。: The deployment confirmation policy is invalid.
节点网络或链历史与部署记录不一致，请检查配置。: The node network or chain history does not match the deployment record. Check the configuration.
节点暂时无法读取最终确认进度，请稍后重试。: The node cannot read finality progress right now. Try again shortly.
节点或记录暂不可用，请保留交易哈希后重试。: The node or records are unavailable. Keep the transaction hash and try again.
请在 MetaMask 中开启显示测试网络，并选择 Ethereum Sepol: Enable test networks in MetaMask and select Ethereum Sepolia.
使用 MetaMask 在 Ethereum Sepolia 部署合约。手续费从: Deploy on Ethereum Sepolia with MetaMask. Fees are paid from your project wallet’s Sepolia test ETH balance.
请使用配置中的项目钱包，并切换到 Ethereum Sepolia。: Use the configured project wallet and switch to Ethereum Sepolia.
项目钱包暂无 Sepolia 测试 ETH，请先补充测试币用于手续费。: The project wallet has no Sepolia test ETH. Add test funds to pay deployment fees.
等待 Sepolia 打包交易: Waiting for Sepolia to include the transaction
交易已进入区块 {0}，最终确认进度为 {1}。确认完成后保存部署记录。: The transaction is in block {0}; finalized progress is at {1}. The deployment record will be saved after finality.
关闭本机服务不会删除 Sepolia 合约。再次启动会继续原来的部署计划和交易记: Stopping local services does not remove Sepolia contracts. Restarting resumes the saved plan and transactions. Keep .local/sepolia/.
已保存的部署记录与链上核验不一致，请保留文件并排查。: The saved deployment record does not match the chain. Keep the file for investigation.
取用武器、加热、敲击。每次进度都会保存。: Choose a weapon, heat it, then strike. Your progress is saved.
收藏封存的武器，所有权与交易记录保存在当前连接的区块链。: Collect sealed weapons, with ownership and trades recorded on the connected blockchain.
从领剑处领取基础剑，也可以消耗铁块锻造新武器。: Claim a daily sword or use iron to forge a new one.
使用游戏金币购买材料或新武器。: Spend game gold on iron or a new weapon.
游戏进度由本机服务保存 · 链上交易通过钱包确认: Progress saved by your local server · On-chain transactions confirmed in your wallet
完成 NFT 业务合约部署后，这里将开放铭刻与交易。普通锻造和仓库现在就能使用。: Minting and trading will open after the NFT contracts are deployed. Forging and weapon storage are available now.
链上监听尚未启动。: The chain listener has not started yet.
节点返回了不匹配的事件，本批次未保存。: The node returned a mismatched event. This batch was not saved.
这个环境已有监听进程在运行。: A listener is already running for this environment.
监听启动失败，请检查配置和节点。连接凭据不会输出。: The listener could not start. Check its settings and node connection. Connection credentials are not displayed.
已完成当前确认边界的事件补扫和 NFT 索引。: Event catch-up and NFT indexing have reached the current confirmed boundary.
